rev6.release_notes: Simulate: the Toolpath box hides every toolpath line and a new Rapid moves box hides the rapid moves; both are on by default. Toolpath Studio's General page is a table. Opened from CAD CAM, G-SEND.IO comes up maximized.

cadcam.release_notes: Simulate's Toolpath and Rapid moves boxes as in G-SEND.IO. Right-click DRILL on the ribbon, or the Tool row of a Drill / Tap / Thread Mill / Spiral window, to open the Drill Chart; typing after clicking a row goes to its search box. OPEN IN CODE EDITOR and SIMULATE open G-SEND.IO maximized.
